deviations.what: fixer_levels is a list of strings, one per level, each six key=value fields ("level=1 actor=qwen-fixer reviewer=codex-reviewer pool=qwen-spark2 queue=pr-fixer enabled=true"), parsed strictly (bad_levels fails closed), instead of a list of objects; the dispatch rule matches data.queue == pr-fixer or data.levels_var == fixer_levels (a field only queue.progress stamps on the reserved dispatch event) instead of data.queue in vars
deviations.reason: shared variables hold only a JSON scalar or a list of scalars (culture_rules/model/variable.py); widening them touches the model, the store, the pinned API and the web Variables tab; the condition language has no path into a list, and a separate fixer_queues variable could drift from fixer_levels and lose dispatches

deviations.what: A level counts as unavailable when its actor is unknown, deleted or disabled, when the actor's daily token_budget is spent (actor_usage), or when it is in a capacity cooldown (fixer_cooldowns, id = the level's actor, {until}); a pool's concurrency cap is not a reason to skip (the request waits its turn in that level's queue)
deviations.reason: the plan said 'pool over budget'; a full pool is a queue position, not unavailability, so skipping on it would escalate a try just because Qwen is busy

deviations.what: Once fixer_levels is seeded, the live queue runs in levels mode even with only level 1 enabled: an unavailable qwen-fixer (disabled, out of budget) hands the story back once (no_fixer_available, final status text) instead of the run failing at the agent step; a closed PR or moved head is still dropped silently
deviations.reason: the hand-back path the plan asked for applies to every level, level 1 included; it changes live behaviour at the rollout that seeds fixer_levels, which the rollout notes must say

deviations.what: The status comment's story root follows a retry's rules.run.failed link too (fixer_status.chain_root calls lineage.upstream(failed=True) for an enqueuer, as the push lineage does), so a timeout or capacity retry keeps one status comment per story and the queue's no_fixer_available hand-back reaches it; lineage.is_enqueuer and RUN_FAILED become public, fixer_levels.parse_until public
deviations.reason: an existing d37 bug: a retry's queue.add started by rules.run.failed became its own story root, opening a second status comment and losing t2's hand-back text (confirmed on the unchanged code)
